help.title: Help
help.hierarchyBody: The legal standard sits in the top bar; the outer container is an argument; the inner cards are sub-arguments; the blue cards are evidence.
help.linkageBody: Hovering an evidence card previews it on the left; clicking commits the focus and highlights the matching paragraph on the right; the magnifier or a citation opens the full page at 3×.
help.manualBody: Use the exhibit chips and the pager to move through the documents.
